column3: The weakest hunter in the world became the strongest.
And the first thing his new power asked of him wasn't a battle, or a secret technique. It was push ups.
Solo Leveling is a story about leveling up. But underneath the shadows and the boss fights, it's really a story about habits.
And psychologists have actually studied how habits form. Some of what they found would make Jinwoo's system proud. Some of it might surprise you.
